text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle won. However, she was made 
keenly aware that she was still no match 
for the intrinsic brilliance of Symboli 
Kris S's running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, having lofty aspirations with 
eyes fixed firmly on the goal. That is 
something Hishi Miracle does not possess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could she truly keep up with all of this 
going forward? Hishi Miracle was seized by 
intense anxiety.
